itemDecisions.comment: Media Type section renders with Print to Paper default. UI.
Save as Electronic File + required fields opens a checkbox-gated acknowledgement modal. UI.
Confirming the acknowledgement modal closes both modals and creates the Work Queue item. UI. Writes a real Work Queue entry using fabricated requester/approver data.
Cancelling the acknowledgement modal leaves the Paper Out modal open with no Work Queue item created. UI.
eoRequestExport with no mediaType is accepted unchanged. API, contractSource UNVERIFIED, automationDecision REVIEW_REQUIRED — scaffolding only until PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION observes the real contract.
eoRequestExport rejects any mediaType other than PrintToPaper/SaveAsElectronicFile. API, contractSource UNVERIFIED, automationDecision REVIEW_REQUIRED.
UI Print to Paper, transaction level, determines Media Type Paper. UI.
UI Print to Paper, document level, determines Media Type Paper. UI.
UI Save as Electronic File, transaction level, determines Media Type Electronic. UI.
UI Save as Electronic File, document level, determines Media Type Electronic. UI.

API mediaType=PrintToPaper, transaction level, determines Media Type Paper. HYBRID (Gate 2 decision on CLR-TP-EC-12000-001): API call sets state, UI audit trail confirms it. contractSource UNVERIFIED, automationDecision REVIEW_REQUIRED — scaffolding only until PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION observes the real contract.
